svg.text: HOW OBJECT ANALYTICS + TIME DISAMBIGUATE THE CPDAG
Four scenarios where flat tables stall and longitudinal objects settle the orientation.

g.text: Takeaway: sepsis bundle (3h door-to-abx) only becomes an identifiable estimand once the admission object carries event clocks.

svg.text: An object-analytics engine keeps the things a flat table throws away: event timestamps, start/stop runs, diagnosis dates, and immutability-at-birth.
These constraints collapse the Markov equivalence class to a single oriented DAG — turning flagged edges into identifiable estimands for TMLE and longitudinal g-methods downstream.
